name: auth-service-backend
description: Reusable Express auth service: email + Google login, JWT refresh rotation, MariaDB

scripts.migrate: sequelize-cli db:migrate --config src/config/sequelize-config.js --models-path src/models --migrations-path src/migrations --seeders-path src/seeders
scripts.migrate:undo: sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo --config src/config/sequelize-config.js --models-path src/models --migrations-path src/migrations --seeders-path src/seeders
scripts.seed: sequelize-cli db:seed:all --config src/config/sequelize-config.js --models-path src/models --migrations-path src/migrations --seeders-path src/seeders
